records.name: huff

records.description: Huff is a gift wishlist app that skips the link-sharing. No groups, no shared links, no awkward "what do you want?" texts. Just open huff and know exactly what to get the people you care about. Live in the US, UK, UAE and India.

records.name: CodeHarborHub

records.name: JustWish

records.description: JustWish brings people together before the party. It's a beautifully designed birthday countdown app with real-time "multiplayer" presence. Create unlimited timers, manage them easily, and use our 1-click "Wish Again" feature to roll timers over to next year — plus AI-powered gift suggestions to make every birthday unforgettable.

records.description: Create stunning posters and vector graphics with Snaposter. A professional web-based SVG vector editor featuring polygonal sculpting, 300+ Google fonts, instant mockups, and real-time canvas sync.

records.name: Urself AI
records.tagline: AI that learns you, so you can understand better yourself.
records.description: Urself AI is helps you to create a AI version of yourself, for self-awareness, goals, moods, and life decisions. It learns your personality, daily patterns, memories, and thoughts over time, then helps you understand yourself better, think clearly, and grow without turning your private life into a public feed. Its private, gets better over time and helps you take tougher and better decision which is hard for you to take.

records.name: Flowtig.com
records.tagline: Modular business apps that grow with your company.
records.description: Flowtig is a modular business platform that lets companies choose only the apps they need. Instead of juggling multiple disconnected tools, teams can manage file sharing, contacts, invoicing, time tracking, documentation, and more in one integrated workspace. Start with a single app and expand as your business grows while keeping a consistent user experience, centralized administration, and seamless integration between applications.

records.name: PSLogo

records.description: PSLogo combines AI and Photoshop tools to design logos, edit images, and generate art. Free online platform for all your creative needs. Try now!

records.name: Cofound Agent
records.tagline: Your AI agent finds your human co-founder
records.description: Cofound is an agent-native directory of human co-founders, powered by Model Context Protocol (MCP). Connect your AI agent (Claude, Cursor, ChatGPT, Codex), and it searches the directory, screens inbound pitches, and drafts intros on your behalf. You review only the conversations worth your time. No feed to scroll, no inbox to grind, privacy by design. Built for AI-native builders looking for a real human partner.
